name: Sasazuka
tagline: Five minutes to Shinjuku, with originating trains and rent that hasn't caught up.
summary: The Keio Line reaches Shinjuku in five minutes. Trains on the Keio New Line — which runs through onto the Toei Shinjuku Line — originate here, so you can sit down on the way in. Despite being in Shibuya Ward, rent stays moderate, and a shopping street plus several supermarkets cover daily needs.
goodFor: People who want a Shibuya Ward address at a lower rent
People who want a seat in the morning
notFor: People who want a quiet residential street
People who want a large park nearby
People who care about neighborhood style
residentComment: Five minutes from Shinjuku at this rent is reason enough to look. The originating trains matter too. The streets themselves are unremarkable, but as a practical place to live it performs very well.
